The story so far

A second home, scooped fresh

LUMA started in Mooloolaba on the Sunshine Coast, serving gelato a different way. In October 2026 it opened the doors to store number two, right here in Newstead.

LUMA calls itself Australia's first self serve gelateria. There is no counter between you and the cabinet. You take a cup, you serve yourself, and your gelato is weighed, so a little of three flavours costs the same kind of decision as a lot of one.

Everything is made fresh daily, and the cabinet changes with what the team is churning. The Newstead store sits at LIV Anura on Skyring Terrace, a short stroll from the river and the Gasworks end of the suburb.

Build your cup, scoop by scoop

This is the fun of self serve. One flavour or three, a neat stack or a glorious mess. These are three scoops LUMA has been serving and posting lately.

  • Pistachio

    Rich and nutty, in that deep green that gives it away before the first spoonful.

  • Tiramisu

    Coffee soaked and creamy, the classic Italian dessert turned into a scoop.

  • Aperol Spritz Sorbet

    Bright, bittersweet and made with real Aperol.

    Limited

The cabinet rotates, so call in to see what has been churned today. More flavours wait in store than any page can list.

The cabinet, the cup, the street

Keep scrolling and take the short walk every visit makes, from the tubs in the cabinet to the footpath outside on Skyring Terrace.

Self serve means you are in charge

No ordering at a counter and no set sizes. The whole ritual takes about a minute, and it goes like this.

  1. 1

    Pick up a cup

    Start at the cabinet and take the cup that matches your appetite, modest or ambitious.

  2. 2

    Serve yourself

    Scoop straight from the tubs. One flavour all the way down, or a different one at every level.

  3. 3

    Weigh and enjoy

    Your cup is weighed, so you pay for what you actually scooped. Then it is straight to the footpath, spoon in hand.
